LanguageData.CRO_Bondsmith_Calling_Text: {PAWN} has begun hearing a vast, ancient voice. It is the {SPREN} — one of the three godspren of Roshar. The voice calls to them, offering a bond unlike any other. Only three Bondsmiths can exist at once, each bound to one of these immense beings.\n\nWill {PAWN} answer the call?
LanguageData.CRO_Bondsmith_Dialog_Subtitle: The {SPREN} has chosen you. There is only one path forward.
LanguageData.CRO_BondDeath_Bondsmith_Text: {PAWN}'s bond with the {SPREN} has been severed. The godspren has withdrawn to the Cognitive Realm, their connection shattered. {PAWN} is no longer a Bondsmith of the {ORDER} order.
